Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in designing fluorinated amide (TFA) and siloxane crosslinker (DMSEA) monomers that co-participate in Li+ solvation while hydrogen bonding and ─CF3 groups anchor PF6− anions. This dual regulation yields high Li+ conductivity (4.9×10−4 S cm−1), stable Li plating over 1000 h, and 91.44% capacity retention after 200 cycles, establishing a solvation-structure-plus-anion-anchoring paradigm for advanced gel polymer electrolytes.

item.title: A Seawater-Compatible Nanocluster Dilute Electrolyte for Low-Cost Long-Lifespan Four-Electron Zn–I2 Batteries
item.description:
الکترولیت رقیق نانوخوشه‌ای بر پایه SBMA با تفکیک دامنه‌های آب، بازگشت‌پذیری I0/I+ و پایداری آند Zn را بهبود می‌بخشد و باتری Zn–I2 چهارالکترونی با بیش از 16000 چرخه ارائه می‌دهد.
ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a low-cost dilute nanocluster electrolyte (SBMA) that creates hydrophobic-interior nanoclusters, partitioning water into activated/nonactivated domains. This suppresses water activity, enables reversible I⁰/I⁺ conversion via quaternary ammonium–ICl₂⁻ coordination, and stabilizes the Zn anode. Significance: over 16,000 cycles at 10 A g⁻¹, and seawater-compatible operation exceeding 12,000 cycles, enabling sustainable, low-cost four-electron Zn–I₂ batteries.
🏷 zinc-iodine battery · four-electron redox · dilute electrolyte · nanocluster electrolyte · seawater electrolyte
